## Project

Build a simple, reliable Three.js shell game with 5 increasing-difficulty levels.

## Rules

- Use vanilla JavaScript, HTML, and CSS.
- Use Three.js and Vite only; no backend or extra runtime dependencies.
- Keep cup identity stable while swapping positions.
- Use a state machine and Raycaster for cup selection.
- Do not use alerts or external visual assets.
